description:
Install any app on Samsung Tizen devices — TVs, projectors and smart monitors

Cross-platform desktop installer that side-loads any app onto Samsung Smart TVs, projectors and smart monitors running Tizen OS — Jellyfin, Moonlight, Moonfin, Litefin and a community catalog, or your own WGT package. Handles device discovery, Tizen certificates and installation. Successor to Jellyfin2Samsung.Jellyfin2Samsung.
📦 v2.7.3 — 2026-08-05
Changes since v2.7.1.
💾 New: Backup & restore
- Move your whole setup between devices — PC ↔ Mac ↔ phone. Export bundles your settings and your signing certificates into a single file; Import restores them on another device. Because the certificate comes along, the new device skips the Samsung login and can still overwrite/update apps you already installed.
- Desktop: Export/Import buttons in Settings. Mobile: the same, via the share sheet / file picker. The format is shared, so a backup made on desktop imports on the phone and vice-versa.
📱 Mobile
- Fixed the Samsung login hanging on a blank "signInComplete" screen after entering your password — it now completes and returns to the app.
- More reliable connection to newer TVs (Tizen 9): reuses a single developer connection and retries the handshake, fixing a device-ID read that could reset the connection.
🧩 Community apps
- LiteFin and other Jellyfin variants install reliably again — generalized the package-id handling for non-Jellyfin builds, and removed the old-TV package tweaks now that LiteFin ships dedicated builds upstream.
